plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model agent" OR "autonomous language agent") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Catches papers that explicitly position themselves as LLM-agent work regardless of slight naming differences.

queries.query: ("agentic workflow" OR "agent workflow" OR "agentic system" OR "agentic AI") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets the newer engineering vocabulary around agentic systems and workflows that may not use the classic LLM-agent label.

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "function calling" OR "API calling" OR "tool augmentation") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Finds practical work on how agents invoke external tools and APIs, a core capability for real-world systems.

queries.query: ("web agent" OR "browser agent" OR "GUI agent" OR "computer use agent") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Captures agents that act in browsers and software interfaces, a fast-moving applied area with strong engineering relevance.

queries.query: ("multi-agent" OR "multi-agent collaboration" OR "agent society" OR "agent coordination") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Covers architectures where multiple language-model agents coordinate, debate, or divide work.

queries.query: ("planning" OR "task decomposition" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "self-planning") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Targets how agents break down tasks and plan actions, a central architectural dimension beyond prompting.

queries.query: ("ReAct" OR "reasoning and acting" OR "plan-and-execute" OR "reflexion") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Finds papers built around influential agent patterns and descendants that often drive practical implementation changes.

queries.query: ("memory-augmented" OR "agent memory" OR "episodic memory" OR "long-term memory") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Catches work on persistent and working-memory mechanisms that materially change agent behavior over longer tasks.

queries.query: ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR RAG OR "retrieval-augmented agent" OR "knowledge retrieval") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Surfaces agent papers that integrate retrieval or external knowledge, which is highly relevant for practical system design.

queries.query: ("code agent" OR "software engineering agent" OR "coding agent" OR "programming agent") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Focuses on engineering-heavy agent work in coding and software tasks, likely especially useful for this reader.

queries.query: ("benchmark" OR evaluation OR "AgentBench" OR "SWE-bench") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agentic system")
queries.rationale: Targets how agent systems are evaluated, including benchmark-driven work that often reveals practical strengths and weaknesses.

queries.query: ("hallucination" OR reliability OR robustness OR safety) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agentic system")
queries.rationale: Finds papers on failure modes and trustworthiness issues that matter when deploying agents in practice.

queries.query: ("self-reflection" OR "self-critique" OR "iterative refinement" OR "error correction") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Covers mechanisms where agents critique or refine their own outputs, a common practical design pattern.

queries.query: ("workflow automation" OR "task automation" OR orchestration OR "autonomous workflow") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "agentic AI")
queries.rationale: Captures applied work on orchestrating agent steps and automating workflows rather than only single-turn reasoning.

queries.query: ("embodied agent" OR "robotic agent" OR "physical agent" OR "vision-language-action") AND ("LLM" OR "large language model" OR "language model agent")
queries.rationale: Adds the adjacent but important embodied-agent frontier where language models are used for action in physical or visual environments.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan covers the core LLM-agent literature plus distinct practical axes: tool use, planning, memory, retrieval, multi-agent systems, evaluation, reliability, and software-engineering applications. It also includes newer vocabulary like agentic systems and workflows so the search does not miss papers that avoid the exact phrase LLM agent. I skipped overly product-specific framework queries and very abstract theory-only terms, reflecting the reader's preference for engineering-grounded work that changes how agents are built in practice.
